input: Find summer camps that have already announced 2027 dates for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Yoga
candidates.note: Children’s summer day camp; announced weeks include June 7–11, June 21–25 and July 5–9, 2027.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Camp Ruach for children and teens begins June 14, 2027; registration opens February 15.

candidates.name: Christmount
candidates.note: 2027 calendar lists Camp Lakey Gap autism camps in June, Camp Brooke day camp July 13–17, and summer service-learning weeks for teens.

candidates.name: Mason Plumlee Basketball Camps
candidates.note: Overnight basketball camp for ages 10–17, June 21–24, 2027.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: COMPASS academic immersion for rising high-school sophomores through rising college freshmen, June 20–24, 2027.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Six weeklong youth conferences: June 6–12, June 13–19, July 11–17, July 18–24, July 25–31 and August 1–7, 2027.

candidates.name: NovusWay — Lutheridge
candidates.note: Elementary and teen camps plus PreKamp and day camp; published 2027 overnight dates run June 6–July 30.

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: Day camp for rising K–5 and overnight programs for rising grades 2–10; staff page announces camp dates June 13–August 8, 2027.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp for grades 1–11; 2027 sessions run June 7–August 12.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Boys’ one- to four-week overnight camps, June 6–August 6, 2027; also offers teen CIT programs.

candidates.name: Union for Reform Judaism — 6 Points Sports Academy
candidates.note: Jewish overnight sports camp: June 15–27, June 29–July 11 and July 13–25, 2027; teen CIT program also scheduled.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: Nike Smoky Mountain Running Camp at UNC Asheville for ages 11–17; four 2027 sessions starting July 4.

candidates.name: Lifeway — Student Life
candidates.note: Student Life recreation camp at UNC Asheville, July 12–16, 2027.
